units.source_text: 房檐在地面的反映下显得十分明亮，水波的荡漾使倒映也晃荡不定。

en.t: The eaves looked very bright in the reflection from the ground, and the rippling of the water made the reflected image sway unsteadily as well.

units.source_text: 斜阳辉映或月光照耀之时，金阁恍如一种奇妙地流动着的东西，

en.t: When the slanting sun shone upon it, or when it was illuminated by moonlight, the Golden Pavilion seemed like something strangely flowing,

units.source_text: 一种振翅欲飞的东西，这就是由于这种水的光的作用。

en.t: something beating its wings and about to fly away; this was due to the effect of that light from the water.

units.source_text: 由于荡漾的水波的反映，坚固的形态的束缚被解开了。

en.t: Through the reflection of the rippling water, the bonds of its solid form were loosened.

units.source_text: 这种时候，金阁仿佛是用永远飘动的风、水和火焰般的材料建成的。

en.t: At such times, the Golden Pavilion seemed to have been built from materials like wind, water, and flame, forever in motion.
